answer: Tie each identity to its measured round-trip delay from several randomly chosen checkpoints. Like a sparrow's flight timed between posts, that latency map shows where a key actually runs. A thousand clones on one server all map to a single spot, however different their names, so the network groups them and splits one reward among them. Faking a long voyage across many regions needs real hardware in each, and that cost delta makes forged diversity unprofitable.
